players.product: 2D / 3D MEMS probe cards for 12-inch DRAM and NAND wafer test

contracts.signal: Supply of probe cards (semiconductor test devices) to Samsung Electronics (PMT has performed same-type contracts with it in the past three years). PO received 10-07-2026; term 10-07-2026 to 01-10-2027, the end date being the last delivery date in the quotation and subject to change by mutual agreement; no advance payment, paid in full after delivery and inspection; in-house production; supply region Korea.
contracts.value: KRW 7,292,500,000 ex-VAT (28.84% of 2025 separate revenue of KRW 25,287,736,817)
